title: A calmer, more personal MindFuel
details:
We've spent the last while rebuilding MindFuel around one idea: it should be the easiest, safest place to think out loud. Here's what's new for you.

Your reflections are yours. Every reflection now starts as "Just me", so only you can see it. Choose "Community" whenever you want to share, and anything you keep private never appears in feeds, search or on your profile for others.

Today's prompt is waiting for you. Open the app and the day's question is right at the top of Home, ready to answer in a sentence or two. Your streak and your week sit beside it.

Reminders on your terms. Pick the time you'd like your daily reminder in your own timezone, set quiet hours, and choose exactly which notifications you get by push or email. Every email now has a one-tap way to turn it off.

Hear from people you follow. When people you follow share something new, you'll get one short email in the morning. Nothing new, no email.

Messages, upgraded. Send photos (end-to-end encrypted, with location removed), delete messages for yourself or for everyone, swipe a message to reply, mute a chat, or block someone. Messages from people you don't follow now wait in a separate Requests tab.

Light or dark, your choice. Switch between System, Light and Dark from the menu next to your name (or Options on your profile on a phone).

Quicker on your phone. Pages now load much less code, and MindFuel will let you know when a fresh version is ready.

Thank you for reflecting with us. We'd love to hear what you think, so just reply to this email. 💚

title: See Who’s Online & Share Thoughts in DMs.
details:
Online and offline indicators — See when people are available across chats, profiles, thoughts, search results, follower lists, and connection suggestions.

Share thoughts to DMs — Send any thought to a private conversation from its share menu, with the thought link prepared in your encrypted chat before you send it.

title: Real-Time Chat, Connections & a More Polished MindFuel.
details: MindFuel now makes it easier to connect beyond the feed. Follow people whose reflections resonate with you, see follower and following relationships, and continue the conversation through real-time private messaging. Chats include typing indicators, delivery and seen states, unread counts, emoji support, resilient message history, and instant in-app or push notifications when you are away. Stay Mindful. 💚

title: A Fresh Look and a Better MindFuel Experience.
details: MindFuel has a refreshed interface designed to feel calmer, clearer, and easier to use. The landing page now tells our story more clearly, the feed has an improved view switcher, mobile refresh is back, navigation feels more polished, and joining MindFuel is faster and more welcoming. Everything is tuned to help you spend less time figuring things out and more time reflecting, connecting, and growing.

title: Onboarding, Milestones, Limits & UI Polish.
details: We now have a smooth onboarding experience, Milestones and badges are now live, older reflections can backfill missed badges, the post and edit character limit has been raised to 1000 words, the reflection history is brighter, and the app UI has been polished throughout. We also tightened up the MindFuel badge/widget experience for a smoother PWA feel.

title: Hashtags + UX Polish
details: Hashtags are here. Browse #tags in your posts, tap a tag to explore its page, and enjoy smart suggestions and trending picks.

title: Quotes, Reposts & Premium Sharing.
details: We've added quotes and reposts, improved image sharing, and a new minimalist card downloader. Share your thoughts more powerfully than ever.
